proposals.evidence: DEDR990(b) explicitly gives Parji okut/okti one thing. Survey okti same is a comparative use of that same-language one-thing form for identity, retaining the elicited same gloss; it belongs to the existing *okk- subgroup rather than the other numeral-one branches. This is a comparative family proposal; inheritance versus local transmission in this survey lect remains subject to review.
